typical-antiphon-1.refrain: Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, O Savior, save us.
verses: Bless the Lord, O my soul; and all that is within me, bless His holy name.
Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all His benefits.
Who forgiveth all thine iniquities, Who healeth all thy diseases.
Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; Who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies.
The Lord executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is His mercy toward them that fear Him.
As far as the east is from the west, so far hath He removed our transgressions from us.
Bless the Lord, all ye His angels, that excel in strength, that do His commandments.
typical-antiphon-1.glory: Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.
typical-antiphon-1.gloryRefrain: Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, O Savior, save us.

typical-antiphon-2.refrain: Save us, O Son of God, who art risen from the dead, who sing to Thee: Alleluia.
typical-antiphon-2.refrainWeekday: Save us, O Son of God, who art wondrous in Thy saints, who sing to Thee: Alleluia.
verses: Praise the Lord, O my soul. I will praise the Lord while I live; I will sing praises unto my God while I have my being.
Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the Lord his God.
Who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that therein is; Who keepeth truth forever.
Who executeth judgment for the oppressed; Who giveth food to the hungry. The Lord looseth the prisoners.
The Lord preserveth the strangers; He relieveth the fatherless and widow.
The Lord shall reign forever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations.
typical-antiphon-2.glory: Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.
